clue.text: Famous woman taking two drugs

parts.note: heroin is an opiate drug
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A celebrity reported to be using a couple of narcotics.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman admired and celebrated for her deeds is a female hero, so famous fits.

clue.text: Homer had several. Elephant has one

indicators.note: has signals that the word Elephant contains the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A trivia contrast: the poet Homer had many of something, an elephant just one.
explanation.walkthrough: Homer is not the poet but a Hebrew dry measure equal to ten of the smaller Biblical measure, so a homer 'had several'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Biblical units a homer holds ten of these Hebrew dry measures, hence several of them.

clue.text: Charlie's design on one member of group like alligators

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a design is an aim or intention
an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: Someone's plan to join a band resembling alligators.
explanation.definitionFit: This reptile is a Central and South American relative of the alligator, in the same family.

clue.text: Most reedy attempts in groove

indicators.note: in tells us the word for attempts is placed within the word for groove

parts.note: a rut is a groove worn in a track
a shy is a throw or attempt, so shies are attempts

explanation.surface: A rather nonsensical claim about the reediest tries landing in a channel.
explanation.definitionFit: Rushes are reed-like plants, so the most rush-filled place is the most reedy, a superlative.

clue.text: Take in petticoat, being insufficiently developed

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for take inside the word for petticoat

parts.note: an undergown is a petticoat worn beneath a dress
R is the recipe abbreviation for take, from Latin recipe

explanation.surface: A dressmaker taking in a petticoat for a child who has not grown much.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take in' looks like the dressmaking phrase, but Take gives R and in puts it inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has not reached full size is stunted, not fully developed.

clue.text: In going astray one finds jewelry

indicators.note: In tells us the letter for one sits inside the word for going astray

parts.note: erring means straying from the right path
a means one

explanation.surface: Someone who wanders off finds a piece of jewellery.
explanation.definitionFit: This ornament worn on the ear lobe is an item of jewellery.

clue.text: Office worker's god is London lawyer

parts.note: a temp is a temporary office worker
a lar is a Roman household god

explanation.surface: The deity a clerk worships is a barrister in the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawyer with chambers in the Temple, one of London's Inns of Court, is so called.

clue.text: Stop a lecturer that's 100kg

parts.note: a quint is an organ stop sounding a fifth above

explanation.surface: Halt a lecturer who weighs a hundred kilograms.
explanation.walkthrough: Stop looks like a verb, but it is an organ stop.
explanation.definitionFit: This metric unit of weight equals one hundred kilograms; it once meant a hundredweight.

clue.text: Damaged car air inlet between races

indicators.note: damaged means the letters of car, air and inlet are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: A wrecked car's air intake, between motor races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'between races' looks like a pit-stop moment; it means across ethnic groups.
explanation.definitionFit: Something involving people of different ethnic groups happens between those groups.

clue.text: Sun could be normal in unusually hot tropical period

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for Sunday

indicators.note: in tells us the rearranged normal goes within the rearranged hot
unusually says the letters of hot are rearranged
could be says normal may be rearranged into other letters

explanation.surface: A weather remark that the sun might be ordinary in unusual heat.
explanation.walkthrough: Two anagrams nest: 'could be' scrambles one word, 'unusually' the other, and 'in' sets one inside. 'tropical' means the tropical year, not a hot climate.
explanation.definitionFit: This unit is one twelfth of the tropical year, the time the sun takes to return to the same equinox.

clue.text: In Europe count a king among the Spanish

indicators.note: among says the article and king go inside the Spanish word

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
R is Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A Continental nobleman counts a monarch among the Spaniards.
explanation.definitionFit: A British nobleman of this rank equals a Continental count.

clue.text: Example of ancient bit of sculpture destroyed

indicators.note: destroyed means the letters are wrecked and reassembled
bit of takes just the first letter of sculpture

explanation.surface: A case of an old piece of statuary having been ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is a case or illustration of something, synonymous with an example.

clue.text: What Katisha would have hoped to be, had she been Russian

definitions.text: What Katisha would have hoped to be, had she been Russian

parts.words: What Katisha would have hoped to be, had she been Russian
parts.note: in The Mikado Katisha hopes to marry the heir Nanki-Poo; the wife of a Russian heir to the throne bore this title

explanation.surface: A Gilbert and Sullivan character imagined in Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: Katisha, from Gilbert and Sullivan's comic opera The Mikado, pursues the Mikado's son and heir, Nanki-Poo.
explanation.definitionFit: The title was given to the wife of a Russian crown prince, which Katisha longed to become in Japan.

clue.text: In old uniform spirit is motive force

indicators.note: In tells us the spirit goes inside the old word for uniform

parts.note: ene is an archaic spelling of even, meaning uniform
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Someone in vintage uniform with spirit has drive.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that converts energy into motion is the source of motive power.

clue.text: Support in election resolved into merrymaking

indicators.note: in places the support within the rearranged election
resolved means the letters of election are broken down and remade

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment

explanation.surface: Backing in a vote turned into a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' makes CELETION from ELECTION, with BRA put in.
explanation.definitionFit: Merrymaking is festive fun, the same thing as a party or festivity.

clue.text: Enclose nuts, Prime Minister

parts.note: printers call an en a nut, so ens are nuts
Edward Heath was UK Prime Minister 1970 to 1974

explanation.surface: A demand to surround a crazy PM.
explanation.walkthrough: Nuts looks like mad; printers call the en space a nut.
explanation.definitionFit: To put in a sheath or case is to enclose, a synonym.

clue.text: Record about one that's cunning and insincere

indicators.note: about says the record goes around the numeral for one

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record
I is the Roman numeral one
deep can mean crafty or cunning

explanation.surface: A disc about a sly and two-faced person.
explanation.definitionFit: Feelings that go only as deep as the mouth are expressed but not felt, so false.

clue.text: Composer of amorets

indicators.note: read with Composer, the composer of amorets is something that rearranges those letters

explanation.surface: The writer of some little love songs.
explanation.walkthrough: Composer does double duty: the definition, and with 'of' the signal to rearrange amorets.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a distinguished musician, especially a great composer or conductor.

clue.text: By fifty-one lakes in France we'll gather them in spring, perhaps

definitions.text: we'll gather them in spring, perhaps

parts.note: LI is fifty-one in Roman numerals
lacs is French for lakes

explanation.surface: Beside French lakes, we pick flowers in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: These scented shrubs flower in spring, so are gathered then.

clue.text: Flourishes of Bulgarian kings having no right to consume port

indicators.note: to consume says the kings swallow the port
having no says the letter for right is dropped from kings

parts.note: the medieval rulers of Bulgaria were titled tsars or czars
Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: Showy gestures by Balkan monarchs eating in harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing R gives CZAS, which takes in ADEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadenza is an ornate solo passage, a musical flourish.

clue.text: Dutch disease brought to light

parts.note: gout is a disease of the joints

explanation.surface: An illness from Holland was revealed.
explanation.definitionFit: Unearthed or discovered means revealed, brought to light.

clue.text: Frigid leman somewhat vain

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A cold lover is a bit conceited.
explanation.definitionFit: Vain also means futile or empty, like idle threats or idle hopes.

clue.text: Mark one who galloped from Ghent to Aix

definitions.meaning: St Mark wrote one of the four Gospels

definitions.text: one who galloped from Ghent to Aix
definitions.meaning: Browning's poem How They Brought the Good News from Ghent to Aix has riders carrying good news

explanation.surface: A rider in a famous gallop of poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: The Greek for good news is evangel, so a bringer of good news fits the poem's riders.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gospel writer such as Mark, and a bearer of good news.

clue.text: Mosaic code's new fabric

parts.note: the law of Moses is the Mosaic code

explanation.surface: The rules for a tiled mosaic produce new cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: Mosaic refers to Moses, not tiling.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawn is a fine linen or cotton fabric.

clue.text: Time in French city for apples

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for time goes within the city

parts.note: Rennes is a city in Brittany

explanation.surface: A spell in a French city for apple picking.
explanation.definitionFit: Rennets are varieties of dessert apple.

clue.text: Bait and handle contemptible creature

parts.note: a lug is a handle or projecting ear
a worm is a despicable person

explanation.surface: Tease and manhandle a lowly person.
explanation.walkthrough: Bait and handle look like verbs; Bait is a noun here.
explanation.definitionFit: This marine worm is dug up by anglers for use as bait.
